title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono meet broadcaster Elliot Mintz | 1972
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono met broadcaster Elliot Mintz for the first time on 9 June 1972.

They had been interviewed by Mintz via telephone on 29 April for KLOS-FM in Los Angeles, but this was their first face-to-face interview. The couple, especially Ono, became close to Mintz over the subsequent years.

The encounter took place in Ojai, California, where Lennon and Ono had been staying since the start of the month. Shortly afterwards Mintz, who had recently lost his job at the radio station, left Ojai with the couple for the Bay Area in San Francisco, following a tip-off that Ono’s eight-year-old daughter Kyoko was in the region.
